2025-Q2.reason: The BIR's overhead-by-MDA table (Table 6) skips the health MDAs. Health overhead is worked out from the BIR's own figures: total − personnel − capital − other.

2023-Q4.reason: The BIR's capital-by-function table (Table 13) uses an older programme code list instead of function codes. Capital by health function is worked out from the BIR's own figures: total − personnel − overhead − other.
